nominations.basis: A .gov host of TVA's own that this project can actually read, which the prior pass did not try. Probed with scripts/probe_candidate_pages.py: the page reads 6,425 characters and the verifier's own label test matches the node twice -- in the content region as "Tennessee Valley Authority Home" (the home link/title; the verifier's bounded-scaffold allowance takes the trailing "Home"), and exactly as "Tennessee Valley Authority" in the site-wide navigation, which the verifier accepts for an organisation. What this page is, stated plainly: TVA's Office of the Inspector General, on the tva.gov domain -- not TVA's corporate site, which is tva.com and off-host, and not tva.gov/www.tva.gov, which this session's egress proxy refuses at CONNECT ("Tunnel connection failed: 403" on a plain GET of either robots.txt), the fact behind the prior not_on_a_gov_host record. Two things a reader should weigh: promote files every nomination under the node's own id, so a confirmation here would publish name_labelled_on_own_official_page about the Inspector General's site rather than TVA's main site; and oig.tva.gov/robots.txt answers 200 with the site's own HTML rather than a robots file, which the politeness policy parses to no rules and therefore allows -- that is how the probe read it. Side effect, probed and reported rather than left to be discovered: with --include-positions this page also labels TVA's "Inspector General" post in the content region, and labels none of the other four TVA posts.
